{{Quote|I've made arrangements for you to meet Captain Varley under the guise of selling back that evidence against him. If you can take down his cronies and bring him here, I'll make sure he spills his guts. With him out of the holo, we can shut down this smuggling operation once and for all.|Denell Kel'Vannon to a spacer|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Mac Varley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He eventually deserted CorSec, and was taken into custody by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by private investigator [[Denell Kel'Vannon]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecTrooperFemaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Randomly generated female depictions of Mac Varley, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Mac Varley was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Mac Varley spawned under the generic "corsec_deserter" template, his appearance was randomized under one of four possible depictions. He could either appear as a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Human male wearing either an [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] or a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], or as a brown haired, brown eyed Human female wearing either the officer's uniform or pilot's jumpsuit. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Varley as male, this article assumes that the Human male depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. However, the type of clothing he wore cannot be definitively determined.<ref name="AED" />
